decisions.decision: Dan Proctor to check with other sewer departments on how they handle ADUs; Dan said he would also talk with the Water District.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Munis system was adding amounts to the billing sheets beyond the $10 late fee, which must be corrected before demands can be sent.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Commissioners discussed whether ADU fees should be a flat fee or sliding scale, and whether to charge 50% of the original hook-up cost or of the current hook-up fee; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: dan suggested if the adu is 50% of the size of the house, could they charge 50% of the cost of originally hooking up the house as a fee.
